=ada: them (clitic pronoun, accusative plural; leans on an earlier word)
pad(i)-: foot (classified by the foot sign PES)
tu(wa)-: put, place (written with the PONERE sign)
kwippa: indeed — adverb that opens a clause (the corpus's kwippa; the same spelling kwa/i-pa is written kwi=pa 'but, however' in §11)
warriyamalla: at ease, in comfort (indeclinable; written with the BONUS sign, as classifier or as logogram; meaning approximate)
asa-: sit, dwell (written with the seat sign SOLIUM and its attached mi)
hattal(a)i-: destroy (written with the sign L274, as logogram or as classifier before the spelled word)
hantili-: foremost, first, earlier (written with the FRONS 'front' sign)
=wa=ada: quotative particle + 'them' (=ada, sounded =ara) — fused in one ligature sign
zanta: down (written with INFRA, as is annan 'under')
usa-: lead, bring (here) (classified by the foot sign PES)
irhi-: border, frontier (written with or classified by the boundary sign FINES)
zila: then, thereupon (also sounded zira, the d/l heard as r)
=wa=di: quotative particle + =di 'for himself' (3rd singular reflexive dative, sounded =ri) — fused in one ligature sign
harwa-: road, way (written with the road sign VIA)
i-: go (classified by the walking-feet sign PES₂)
wanatti-: woman, wife (written with the woman sign FEMINA)
sitta-: spindle (classified by the spindle sign FUSUS)
(PES₂.PES₂)da-: walk, pass along — written with two walking feet; the Luwian word behind the picture is unknown
-nti: 3rd person plural present ending — '(they) …' (the n is usually left unwritten)
asiya-: living, dwelling — a noun written with SOLIUM.MI, the 'sit, dwell' sign
Attanawanni-: Adanawan, of Adanawa (Adana) — classified by the city sign URBS

__broaden__.ammu: I; also the dative 'me', 'to/before me' (spelled á-mu, or with the pointing-figure sign EGO)
__broaden__.=mu: me, to me, for me (clitic pronoun, leaning on the first word of the clause)
__broaden__.-nza: two endings spelled alike: the dative-locative plural — 'to, for, in, at' ('in my days', 'in those places'); and the neuter singular nominative/accusative ending of a noun or of an adjective agreeing with it
__broaden__.-di: ablative-instrumental ending — 'from, because of; by, with'
__broaden__.-i: two unrelated endings spelled alike: on nouns, the dative-locative singular — 'to, for, upon'; on verbs, the 3rd person singular present — '(he, she, it) …s'
__broaden__.-ya: two endings spelled alike: on nouns, the dative-locative singular — 'to, for'; on neuter nouns, adjectives and pronouns, the nominative/accusative plural ('good things', 'which')
__broaden__.-ta: 3rd person singular past ending — '(he, she, it) …-ed', 'was'; a neuter plural subject also takes it ('there were')
__broaden__.-nzi: common-gender plural ending, nominative or accusative
__broaden__.-nta: 3rd person plural past ending — '(they) …-ed', '(they) were' (the n is usually left unwritten)
__broaden__.allummida-: a rare word under the fist sign PUGNUS, meaning uncertain — the corpus takes it as an adjective, 'strong'; it may also be read as a noun, 'strong places'
__broaden__.ibami-: the sunset, the west (written with or classified by the setting-sun sign OCCIDENS)
__broaden__.kistami-: the sunrise, the east (written with or classified by the rising-sun sign ORIENS)
__broaden__.=pa: but, and; marks a new topic or a contrast — 'and as for …' (clitic; the corpus's =ba)
__broaden__.harnissa-: fortress (written with or classified by the fortress-wall sign CASTRUM)
__broaden__.Azzattiwada-: Azatiwada — the ruler who speaks this inscription (his name may mean 'beloved of the Sun'); between vowels the d may be sounded r (Azzattiwaras)
__broaden__.-n: accusative singular ending — marks the object
__broaden__.isnuwa-: seat, settle — 'make sit' (written with or classified by the seat sign SOLIUM)
__broaden__.hassa-: satiety(?), luxury(?) — classified by the licking-mouth sign; the nuance is a scholarly guess

CAPUT-tt(i)-: man, person — written with the head sign CAPUT; the corpus leaves the Luwian word open (§1 and §20 read the sign ziti-)
walilid(a)-: territory, open land — the corpus's lemma for the word written TERRA+LA+LA (transcribed warranza); reading and meaning uncertain
